data.headline: HUBCO plans to produce 50,000 electric vehicles annually:
data.summary: HUBCO has announced plans to establish a plant capable of producing 50,000 electric vehicles (EVs) annually, with 30-40 per cent of the output earmarked for export to Australia and Africa.

data.headline: Hub Power sees falling power demand on high tariffs
data.summary: Hub Power Co Ltd (Hubco), the country’s largest private utility, expects power consumption in the country to fall again this year due to higher tariffs and tepid industrial activity, a top executive told Reuters.

data.headline: Hubco to acquire another 9.5% stake in SECMC
data.summary: The Hub Power Company Limited has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire additional 9.5%stake in Sindh Engro Coal Mining Company Limited (SECMC) held by Habib Bank Limited (HBL).
